Bug_Title: EC: Using pointer equality to compare different types (EC_UNRELATED_TYPES_USING_POINTER_EQUALITY)
Bug_Details:
This method uses pointer equality to compare two references that seem to be of
different types. The result of this comparison will always be false at runtime.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by using pointer equality (==) to compare a String and an Integer. This will always return false at runtime because they are of different types.
Seed_Compilation_Fail_Details:
spotbugs_clean_java_code/result_Spotbugs_72/seed_Spotbugs_72.java:4: error: incomparable types: String and Integer
        return str == num; // BUG: EC: Using pointer equality to compare different types (EC_UNRELATED_TYPES_USING_POINTER_EQUALITY)
                   ^
1 error
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method with a String and an Integer, which uses pointer equality to compare different types.
